name: I1 — cxj: click path + parser + chips
description:
Spec: design/09-rich-links/README.md (§3 grammar, §4 resolver, §5 rendering) + design/09-rich-links/richlinks.catalog.json. Mockup: design/09-rich-links/01-mockup/index.html.

Why: today Markdown.vue (~lines 121-128) intercepts EVERY anchor click and emits `link`, and nothing in client/ listens to it — plain https links are already dead. This increment fixes that and makes hand-written `cxj:` links work.

Do:
1. client/src/components/Markdown.vue — keep html sanitisation; stop swallowing all anchors. Route external http(s) through a real handler; route href starting with `cxj:` to the rich-link renderer.
2. New client/src/utils/richlinks/parser.js (pure, no DOM): parse `cxj:<kind>/<id>[?params]`, percent-decoding, validation, never throws (returns {ok:false,raw}).
3. New client/src/utils/richlinks/registry.js — kind registration table read from the catalog shape (idPattern, target, card, url, ai.emit).
4. New client/src/utils/richlinks/resolver.js — maps {kind,id,params} to openApp(appKey, payload) from client/src/config/apps.js via client/src/router/navigate.js; works in desktop-panel and single/mobile mode.
5. New client/src/components/richlinks/RichLink.vue — chip: icon + label + kind badge, keyboard accessible (Enter/Space), aria-label, contextmenu copy-link.
6. markdown-it plugin (client/src/utils/richlinks/markdown-it-richlinks.js) so a markdown link `[label](cxj:task/<id>)` is rendered as the chip component (Vue hydration), unknown kind degrades to plain text.
7. P0 kinds only: chat, task, file, event, meet, message, profile.

Acceptance:
- A hand-written `[x](cxj:task/<id>)` inside a chat message opens the task in BOTH desktop and single/mobile mode.
- An unknown kind renders as literal text, no error, no dead click.
- Plain https links open again (regression on the current bug).
- Unit tests for parser + resolver (valid, malformed, unknown kind, percent-encoded params).

Files: design/09-rich-links/*, client/src/components/Markdown.vue, client/src/config/apps.js, client/src/router/navigate.js
